catalogue.description_en:
This basic training teaches God Arc fundamentals
and allows you to practice them on a sparring 
dummy. Reviewing this training is recommended 
before accepting a live mission.

Here, you will learn God Arc fundamentals and 
practice them on a sparring dummy. In addition, 
you will learn how to recover materials and items 
from the battlefield. Reviewing this training is 
recommended before accepting a live mission.

Cocoon Maidens are breeding on the abandoned
carrier. They may pose a threat if neglected. 
Retaliation Squad requested to eliminate the 4 
Aragami. Be cautious of uneven ground.

Some resource traders who ignored our warning and
continued operation in the Old City have been
taken prey by 1 Chi-You, still in the area.
Retaliation Squad requested for clean up.

Detected 1 Quadriga, a tank-type Aragami in the
grasslands. Dispatch requested. Not much is known
about the giant other than its weakness to 
Freeze. Beware of its smaller Aragami 
accompaniments.

Defeat the 2 Gboro-Gboros and 1 Fallen Ogretail 
in the abandoned factory. Spark is effective against
Gboro-Gboros, while the Fallen Ogretail is 
adapted to the cold. Blaze weapons will prove 
useful.

Destroy 1 Borg Camlann before it crawls out of 
the subway remains. These Aragami look like giant
scorpions. Freeze and Spark may be effective.
Avoiding the Fallen Cocoon Maidens is suggested.

Research Unit has detected a swarm of Ogretails 
in the abandoned factory. Your target is 3 Ogretails 
and 2 Fallen Ogretails. All Ogretails are weak to
Sunder and piercing close-range attacks.

1 Quadriga confirmed in the bay district. Head to 
the landing point and defeat it. We have found 
that Quadriga have low resistance to Freeze and 
Divine attributes. Keep this in mind.

1 Vajra was encountered by the Research Unit's
force reconnaissance but has escaped to the Old
City. Blaze or Divine weapons are recommended.
Take caution of other smaller Aragami.

Defeat 2 Cocoon Maidens and 1 Zygote in the
grasslands. All are magmatic. Freeze is effective
for these fallen species. Beware of the Cocoon's
killzone. This is not a difficult mission.

Defeat two Fallen Ogretails in the grasslands. They
are polar phenotypes, so Blaze weapons are
advised. The terrain is flat and Zygotes are on
the lookout. Prepare for a chaotic battle.

Defeat a Borg Camlann in the bay district. 
Destroying its hard armor and needle tail should 
be a priority. Freeze and Spark weapons will help 
get this done quickly.

A Quadriga has begun actively devouring in the
temple ruins. Freeze weapons are proven valid.
Parts of a Quadriga are weak to Impact—crushing
weapons are thought to have a slight advantage.

Defeat a Borg Camlann that was detected in the 
temple ruins. Freeze and Spark weaponry is 
advised. The target is accompanied by Zygotes and 
Fallen Ogretails. Engaging multiple hostiles is 
dangerous and should be avoided where possible.

A swarm of Aragami confirmed in the Old 
Underground City. The main threat seems to be a 
Fallen Chi-You and Fallen Gboro-Gboros. The 
Zygotes have made the situation complicated. 
Take caution.

Eliminate the 2 Vajras in the temple ruins. 1 is 
a Prithvi Mata, which some say is a female Vajra
and others say it is a fallen species. Either 
way, Blaze and Divine are effective on both.

Eliminate 2 polar Kongous and 1 Gboro-Gboro at 
the temple ruins. If this mission is successful, 
we can secure a high level of safety. We can then
repair the barrier to the residential area.

Research Unit has trapped a Dyaus Pita in the Old
City after long pursuit. Destroy the evolved
Vajra, the king of beasts, along with a Prithva
Mata in the area. Spark and Freeze are useless.

Defeat the Prithvi Mata in the Old City. The 
Guard Squad is at a stalemate with the swarm of 
small Aragami. This icy queen is dangerous, but a
crushing blow to the head should determine its
fate.

Eliminate 1 Vajra and 1 magmatic Gboro-Gboro in
the subway remains. Both the Vajra's head and
Gboro-Gboro's forehead are weak to crush attacks.
Focus fire on one at a time to make things easier.

The abandoned factory became an Aragami nest while
Fenrir's chain of command was in chaos. Rush to
the scene and eliminate 1 polar Kongou, 1
Gboro-Gboro, and 1 Chi-You. Blaze weaponry
is advised.

A Fallen Ouroboros has become active in the 
grasslands. This rare species has become 
increasingly common of late. Though we know they 
are weak to Divine attacks, a giant, free-roaming 
Aragami should still be a cause for concern.

The Aragami threat in the subway remains seems
to be one of the causes of the delays to our
water and air duct construction. We need a
Fallen Gboro-Gboro and a Quadriga eliminated.
Freeze is effective.

A new species of Aragami has descended on Aegis.
The strategic unit has named it Aether, but it
looks like a Sariel and its defenses are believed
to be similar. A polar Zygote is also in the 
area.

Wipe out the Aragami in the Old City. The target
is 1 magmatic Borg Camlann and 1 polar Quadriga.
Beware of its opposite Blaze-and-Freeze
combination.

Eliminate 2 polar Gboro-Gboros at the chemical
factory ruins. Fenrir PR seeks to make use of
Aragami waste to secure resources. Note that this
includes reusing Gboro-Gboro skin as alligator
hide.

Destroy a charged Chi-You, a Sekhmet, and a Dyaus 
Pita in the subways. Head shots are effective. In 
particular, piercing attacks work on the charged 
Chi-You and Sekhmet, while the Dyaus Pita is 
susceptible to crushing.

The Research Unit monitoring an Aether in the Old 
City was ambushed by a Dyaus Pita. There were 
some casualties, but they just about managed to 
beat a retreat. The two Aragami must be defeated. 
Divine weapons are recommended.

Rush to the factory ruins and defeat 1 polar
Quadriga and 1 Fallen Sariel. Blaze weapons are
advised. The toxic lake is home to the Sariel.
Teach it a lesson: there is no resting place for
Aragami.

Targets sighted in the Old City: 1 Sekhmet, 1
Fierce Kongou, 1 polar Kongou and 1 polar
Gboro-Gboro. Fighting multiple species at once 
can be very dangerous. Try to separate them.

Destroy 1 Tezcatlipoca and 1 Prithvi Mata in the
abandoned factory. Divine weapons should prove 
useful. To note, a search was executed on the 
cult, and all suspicious persons have been found.

Eliminate 1 Prithvi Mata and 2 Sekhmets nesting 
in the temple ruins. Blaze and Freeze weapons are
suggested. The bracelet and left arm of a runaway
rookie was found. Assume the rest of his body was
eaten.

A convoy delivering materials from Aegis was
attacked by an Arda Nova, which have no 
weakness to note. Retaliation Squad requested on 
site. The Guard Squad will secure your escape 
route.

Rush to the old bay district to defeat a Dyaus Pita
and a charged Borg Camlann. The charged Borg's
head is weak to Blaze, while sunder is effective
on the front legs of the Dyaus Pita.

Defeat a charged Borg Camlann and an Aether in 
the temple ruins. Blaze or Divine equipment is 
required. Side note: Ironically, the Aether has 
attracted the most attention in Fenrir PR's 
recently published "God Eaters vs. Aragami" photo 
book.

Eliminate a Dyaus Pita and a Prithvi Mata on Aegis. 
Take a trusty Divine weapon with you. Both tyrants' 
heads are weak against impact, so use crushing 
attacks to split them wide open.

Retaliation Squad requested to defeat 1 Fallen
Ouroboros in the grasslands. Divine is effective,
but the reason is unknown. We don't know where
they come from, but we must defeat them all.

The Fallen Arda Nova has returned to Aegis. There
is a public live broadcast, which means this 
battle will represent us. No weakness of this 
Aragami has been found. Good luck in battle.

Learn how to attack specific body parts. Your
objective is to attack each body part and observe
the enemy's reaction. Find the most effective
attack, and try to destroy what holds them
together.

Defense Unit has found a herd of Vajra in
the plains. There were no deaths, but 
serious injuries have been suffered. Requesting
Retaliation Squad to handle this chaotic battle 
on difficult terrain. Aim for a 2 vs 1 battle.

A Fallen Gboro-Gboro adapted to polar climates 
has landed on the carrier. We request a veteran 
to eliminate it quickly. Heavy firepower will 
prove effective against its Freeze attacks.

A Prithvi Mata has been detected in the Factory 
Ruins. It's up to 1st Unit to remove this threat 
to Aegis Island. Though it's by itself, it's still 
a formidable adversary. Go equipped with Blaze and 
Divine gear, and watch your back out there.

Local cold spots have made Kongous develop 
bipolar habitats, and there seems to be a lone 
Fierce Kongou in the Old City. Prepare yourself 
in Divine gear and make use of this chance.

We've received reports of a large, cold-region 
Aragami in the Old City. We believe this to be a 
Fallen Gboro-Gboro. We request your services as a 
veteran God Eater to defeat it for us. Be sure to 
take your Blaze gear with you.

A Fallen Borg Camlann with resistance to heat is
interfering with a retrieval mission at the
chemical plant. Chemicals can become a threat, so
we need it gone, quick. The key is to take Freeze
gear.

The Research Unit reported a large fire in the 
Old City last night. This was determined to be 
caused by a Quadriga's sudden rampage behavior. 
Destroy this with Freeze type bullets.

It has been confirmed that the Freeze burn
injuries suffered by the Research Unit at the
factory ruins were caused by a Fallen Quadriga.
This threat must be removed immediately.

The Aethers near the stranded carrier has become 
a serious problem for plant transportation 
missions from Aegis. We ask for a fully Divine-
equipped God Eater to carry out this mission.

We have learned that a charged Chi-You escaped a 
recent large-scale sweep. Scouts have located it 
in the vicinity of the grasslands. It must be 
defeated. Carrying a shield to protect you from 
Spark attacks would be prudent.

Something has been sighted rampaging near the bay 
district. We can't be certain, but we believe it's 
a Fallen Gboro-Gboro. Take a Blaze weapon just in 
case, and proceed with caution.

Two Tsukuyomi, Type 1 Deusphages, have been 
detected within Aegis. We're on high alert for 
this unprecedented scenario. Settle things before 
the situation gets out of hand. Focused melee 
attacks on their halos will prove to be a vital 
tactic.

Eliminate 1 Chi-You sighted in the grasslands. 
It's a troublesome Aragami that swiftly flies on
the open grasslands. Destroy the wings with guns
and make sure to suppress it so that it won't fly 
around again.

Requesting defeat of a Kongou and Gboro-Gboro 
spotted in the plains. Spark seems to be effective 
against both, so bear this in mind when selecting 
your weaponry. You may be in for a long fight, so 
prepare accordingly.

Your attacks are weakening the Aragami threat.
Most of these reports are for small ones now. 
Like this: a group of Ogretails in the Old City.
This might sound easy, but never underestimate
the Aragami.

A large Aragami has been detected in the
Marshlands. Info suggests this to be a Hannibal.
However, we have no record of its successful
defeat. Its Blaze attacks will require serious
caution.

A Black Hannibal has been sighted at the Aegis. 
There is not much information on how to defeat it, 
but we know that it uses strong Divine attacks. 
Adjust your gear accordingly.

This is an emergency mission. Susano'o, a Type 1
Deusphage, has been found in the subway remains. 
It has devoured many God Eaters already. Destroy 
it with Divine weapons before you become its 
prey.

The fearful giant, Ouroboros has been sighted in
the Marshlands. It's said that earthquakes are
caused by this dangerous beast. Shatter its front
legs and stop the giant from moving around.

Black Hannibal is officially classified as a 
Corrosive Hannibal species. We have yet to find 
any of its weaknesses. The only suggestion we can 
make is to take armor that shields against Divine 
attacks. Good luck.

Challenge Mission:
A Fallen Zygote and a charged Vajratail. Damn,
it's just trash... Hey, you. Come along. It's got
nothing to do with the Amaterasu nearby! I'm just
offering to split the prize with you.

Challenge Mission:
Shooting down a flying Aragami is pretty hard, 
but it feels so good. There's a Chi-You and its 
fallen species, plus a Fallen Sariel in the 
abandoned factory. So? Wanna come with me?

Challenge Mission:
A Susano'o has been sighted again. I'm not really 
up for it, but it's my job. It's in the Old City.
There's a polar Kongou with it, so it's kinda 
hard for me to handle alone. Please help!

Challenge Mission:
Sorry to bug you. Um... Can you come with me for
my gun training session? The target is a Quadriga
and a Tezcatlipoca. I thought I'd practice on big
enemies first. And thank you, in advance!

Challenge Mission:
The Aragami in the Old City have suddenly 
vanished. We sent in scouts to investigate 
further, and they discovered the likely cause—
a Hannibal and Corrosive Hannibal. Eliminate 
these threats immediately.

Challenge Mission:
I heard Hannibal's popped up again. He's gotten 
us good a few times now, so I need to get 
revenge! There's a Fallen Chi-You in the area, 
but if we team up, they're no match for us!

Challenge Mission:
A Fallen Kongou, Fallen Gboro-Gboro, Sekhmet, 
and Fierce Kongou are headed here. Avert them at 
the carrier. Team up with the Second Squad and 
defend.

Challenge Mission:
The abandoned factory is covered in a thick fog 
caused by the melting of Prithvi Mata's ice by 
Hannibal's heat. Visibility in the region is dire. 
Gear up and go in.

Challenge Mission:
A Prithvi Mata with a polar Kongou and Gboro-
Gboro servants have descended on the temple 
ruins. Use Blaze weapons to hammer away at her 
frozen defenses.

Challenge Mission:
The Fallen Gboro-Gboro, Sekhmet, and Hannibal 
are some Aragami that adapted to the magma when 
the earth erupted. Now, they have gathered in the
subways. Go now and extinguish this threat.

Challenge Mission:
The last contact we heard from our squad 
investigating Aegis was that they had sighted 
Aragami believed to be a Tsukuyomi and a Fallen 
Sariel. Secure Aegis so that we can deploy a 
search team.

Challenge Mission:
Our communication equipment seems to malfunction
in the grasslands. A charged Chi-You, Fierce
Kongou and Vajra have been sighted there. They 
may not be the actual cause, but get rid of them.

Challenge Mission:
A Kongou herd's been detected at the temple ruins 
again. A Kongou, Fallen Kongou, and two Fierce 
Kongous are out there wreaking havoc as if they're 
channeling the anger of the abandoned statues. Get 
over there and put an end to their tantrums.

Challenge Mission:
Suddenly, a Dyaus Pita appeared on Aegis and 
destroyed our defense force. Head to Aegis and
eliminate it now. It's an emergency and we
cannot secure more staff. Give your full 
attention to this mission.

Challenge Mission:
A Hannibal and corrosive Hannibal seem to have
wiped out the Aragami on Aegis. The two have
devoured everything. They are strong, and much 
too dangerous to be left alive. We need them 
defeated, now.

Challenge Mission:
Defeat the Chi-You in the grasslands. This area 
has become dangerous due to the two Fallen
Chi-Yous and two Sekhmet that are flying rampant.
Beware of air strikes that can come from
anywhere.

Challenge Mission: [No Respawn]
Four Aragami have been detected in the chemical 
factory ruins. We believe them to be Cocoon 
Maidens and Fallen Ogretails. Keep an eye out 
above and behind you, and don't even think about 
underestimating them.

Challenge Mission:
There was a plan to shut down Aegis before it
became an Aragami nest, but a Fallen Kongou,
Fallen Gboro-Gboro, Fierce Kongou and a Sekhmet
have been detected. Eliminate them now.

Challenge Mission:
An Aether and Borg Camlann have appeared at the
temple ruins, causing a Cocoon Maiden infestation. 
Fighting within range of their ballistics is 
fraught with danger. Pay attention to your 
surroundings.

Challenge Mission:
A Dyaus Pita and Corrosive Hannibal have been 
spotted fighting each other on Aegis. We cannot 
ignore the havoc being wreaked. Get out there and 
put an end to their fight before Aegis is 
destroyed.

Challenge Mission:
A Dyaus Pita and Prithvi Mata are being tracked 
at the closed off church. A battle in a small 
area with nowhere to run can become harsh. Watch 
for their attacks and aim to destroy their heads.

Extra Challenge Mission
Two Borg Camlanns, two Sariels and two Vajras have 
been confirmed at Aegis. They appear to have been 
devouring in the depths for some time. They all 
show signs of abnormal evolution, so exercise extra 
caution.

Extra Challenge Mission [No Respawn]
A Corrosive Hannibal has been confirmed in the 
Factory Ruins. Vajratails have also set up camp in 
the area. While their senses are sharp, they will 
not notice you if you stay above them. Do not 
allow yourself to be knocked down to ground level.

Extra Challenge Mission
A Kongou, Gboro-Gboro, and Chi-You have broken 
into the ruins of the church. They all seem much 
stronger than ordinary specimens of their kind, so 
be careful. They are thought to be extremely 
dangerous. Evasive hit-and-run tactics are advised.

Extra Challenge Mission
Four Fierce Kongous, four Sekhmets, two Dyaus 
Pitas, and two Corrosive Hannibals have all been 
confirmed on Aegis Island. This dire threat must 
be extinguished as soon as possible. We're all 
counting on you. Give this everything you've got.

The polar Quadriga ambushed by the Defense Unit
has been spotted in the snow-covered temple ruins
and must be eliminated. In addition to the target, 
the area contains a large number of small Aragami. 
Avoid unnecessary battles and focus on the 
objective.

Eliminate a Hannibal and magmatic Gboro-Gboro
in the bay district. Target activity levels are 
low. Though they pose little threat for the time 
being, there's no point in waiting until they do. 
Be aware that magmatic Zygotes are also in the 
area.

Aragami are gathering into a swarm at the temple 
ruins, and must be eliminated before they become 
a problem. The primary targets are two Yaksha and 
a Yaksha Raja. Magmatic Cocoon Maidens are also 
in the area. Move carefully to keep them from 
joining forces.

Eliminate the charged Borg Camlann and charged
Chi-You holding the stranded carrier. The targets
are apparently hiding from God Eaters. Charged 
Cocoon Maiden and Vajratail are also in the area, 
so engaging each enemy individually is advised.

Two Aethers have invaded the temple ruins and are
forming a swarm with smaller Aragami. The pair 
must be eliminated at all costs. Anti-air weaponry 
and a method of dealing with debuffs will stand 
you in good stead.

Charged Chi-Yous are drifting into the chemical 
plant. Three are nesting there currently, and now 
that there is little left to devour, they are 
likely to move on. Destroy the group to prevent 
them from threatening other areas. Blaze weaponry 
is recommended.

A number of medium Aragami are rampaging at the
temple ruins. A Kongou, a Chi-You, and two Gboro-
Gboros have been confirmed so far. The battlefield will
likely be somewhat chaotic, so equip yourself
appropriately.

A Quadriga and a Borg Camlann have appeared in 
the  Old City. A Chi-You is also approaching the 
area,  but you may ignore this at your discretion. 
Separating the targets will be vital to the 
success of this mission. Prepare wisely.

Simultaneous Aragami outbreaks have occurred in the
grasslands and carrier areas. We will engage in a two-part
operation to eliminate them. First, head to the grasslands
and defeat the eight small magmatic Aragami. They may
be weak, but don't forget a fight with a Sariel awaits you
afterward.

Phase 2
Eliminate a Sariel.
Blaze, Freeze, and Spark equipment is recommended.

A charged Borg Camlann and two mid-size polar 
Aragami have appeared in the subway remains. The 
Borg Camlann has since moved to the chemical 
plant, however, necessitating a two-phase 
operation. Begin by eliminating the charged 
Chi-You and the polar Kongou in the subway.

Phase 2
Eliminate one charged Borg Camlann.
Blaze weaponry is recommended.

A Prithvi Mata has appeared in the Old City with a 
retinue of polar Ogretails. In addition, a Kongou 
troop has been reported in the grasslands. This 
will be a two-part mission. In the first phase, 
your targets are the Prithvi Mata and three polar 
Ogretails.

Phase 2
Eliminate a Kongou, a polar Kongou and a Fierce 
Kongou. Blaze and Divine equipment is 
recommended.

A large number of Aragami have appeared in the subway
remains. A Hannibal and magmatic Gboro-Gboros have
been reported. The Hannibal is calling Gboro-Gboros, so
the battle will be drawn out if it is not defeated first. Take
the appropriate precautions.

There have been simultaneous outbreaks of Aragami on
Aegis and at the temple ruins. We will launch a two-part
mission to defeat them. The first phase is the elimination
of the Ravana and magmatic Gboro-Gboro on Aegis. The
Gboro-Gboro is approaching, but has not arrived yet.

Phase 2
Eliminate a Sekhmet, a Fierce Kongou, and a 
Yaksha Raja. Freeze and Divine weaponry is 
recommended.

Aragami outbreaks are occurring in the Old City, 
the grasslands and the carrier. We will undertake 
a three-part mission to eliminate them. The 
primary target for the first phase is a Hannibal 
in the Old City. Freeze and Spark weaponry is 
recommended.

Phase 2
Eliminate a charged Chi-You, a charged Zygote, 
and a charged Vajratail. Blaze or Divine weapons 
are recommended.

Phase 3
Eliminate a Susano'o and an Aether.
Divine equipment is recommended.

Large Aragami have been reported on Aegis. One 
group has split off and gone in the direction of 
the chemical plant. We will undertake a two-part 
operation to eliminate them. In the first phase, 
you will go to the chemical plant to defeat a 
Dyaus Pita, a Prithvi Mata, and four Ogretails.

Phase 2
Eliminate a Quadriga, a magmatic Borg Camlann, and
a Vajra. Freeze and Divine equipment is recommended.

This three-part mission is to eliminate a Sekhmet 
at the chemical plant, a Susano'o at the carrier, 
and an Aether with Fierce Kongous at the temple 
ruins. Phase 1 will consist of defeating the 
Sekhmet. It is accompanied by a number of 
Zygotes—consider these discretionary targets.

Phase 2
Eliminate one Susano'o.
Divine equipment is recommended.

Phase 3
Eliminate an Aether and two Fierce Kongous.
Divine equipment is recommended.

Large Aragami have scattered from the chemical
plant and are reported heading towards Aegis and 
the carrier. Defeat them before they cause more 
damage. This is a three-part mission, starting with 
eliminating a highly toxic Sariel at the chemical 
plant. Using Divine weaponry is not advised.

Phase 2
Eliminate a Venus.
Blaze equipment is recommended.

Phase 3
Eliminate a Ravana and a Quadriga.
Freeze equipment is recommended.

We've detected a powerful Oracle response believed 
to be Aragami arriving on Aegis. Though only an 
Arda Nova is currently confirmed, we predict other 
powerful Aragami are incoming, so this mission 
will be broken into three phases. Please do 
everything you can to resolve this situation.

Phase 2
Eliminate one Corrosive Hannibal.
Freeze, Spark, and Divine equipment is 
recommended.

Phase 3
Eliminate one Arius Nova.
Freeze or Spark equipment is recommended.

A Blitz Hannibal has appeared at the chemical 
plant. It seems to be calling other powerful 
Aragami to various locations. To reduce the 
potential damage, this mission will be broken into 
three phases. Each will be highly dangerous, so 
make sure you're well equipped.

Phase 2
Eliminate two Yaksha Raja.
You are advised against using Divine weaponry.

Phase 3
Eliminate a Tezcatlipoca and a Chi-You.
Divine, Blaze and Freeze equipment is recommended.

An outbreak of polar and other cold-adapted 
Aragami is spreading from the temple ruins. Their 
routes point them toward the carrier and chemical 
plant. This will be a three-part mission, starting 
with the elimination of all cold-adapted Aragami 
in the temple ruins. Don't forget Blaze weaponry.

Phase 2
Eliminate a Prithvi Mata and a polar Quadriga.
Blaze equipment is recommended.

Phase 3
Eliminate four polar Kongous.
Blaze equipment is recommended.

Extra Challenge Mission
Sortilege, a type of fortune-telling lottery, has 
been a tradition in the Far East for ages. A 
device for this was recently found at the temple 
ruins. If you have time, why not get your fortune 
told? (Mission will complete automatically.)

Challenge Mission
A Dyaus Pita relative has appeared on Aegis. Its 
body hardens greatly when activated, and we 
believe breaking bonds is the key to neutralizing 
this effect. We're low on personnel for this 
mission, so remember the above when fighting it.

Predator 1 Challenge Mission: Difficulty 9
Ignoring all warnings, the rally went ahead at the 
temple ruins. A section of the opposing forces were 
wiped out by a Hannibal. However, an S.O.S. has 
been received. Rescue any survivors and eliminate 
the Aragami. Equip freeze or spark weaponry.

Predator 1 Challenge Mission: Difficulty 13
Reports state a Vajra is damaging equipment and 
consuming volatile substances at the chemical plant. 
Leaving it to run loose only heightens the risk of a 
mutation. Proceed to the plant and eliminate the 
target. Equip anything other than spark weaponry.

Predator 1 Challenge Mission: Difficulty 13
A Dyaus Pita has taken down a chopper carrying a 
God Eater. Survivors are in the subway remains, 
but the Aragami has followed them in. The tunnels 
are narrow, making combat extremely dangerous. 
Take the utmost care and eliminate the Aragami.

Predator 1 Enhance Mission: Difficulty 14
We need special Yaksha, Gboro-Gboro, and Hannibal 
cores to upgrade the God Arc's abilities. Find these 
Aragami in the factory ruins. They have consumed 
surrounding Aragami and mutated. We need a lot of 
cores, so a cautious, systematic approach is advised.

Phase 3:
Eliminate a Prithvi Mata and two Sekhmet. Use 
blaze weaponry for the Prithvi Mata and freeze for 
the Sekhmet.

Phase 2
Eliminate a Caligula. Either blaze or spark 
equipment is recommended.

Predator 1 Survival Mission: Difficulty 14
We have sightings of Aragami rampaging near the 
carrier. They have been devouring nearby Aragami 
before vaporizing. Proceed to Phase 3, total 
extermination, quickly. A Ravana and two Yaksha 
Raja are at the carrier - eliminate them.

Predator 1 Challenge Mission: Difficulty 14
A Vajra, Quadriga, Borg Camlann, and Sariel have 
evaded our forces and fled to the factory ruins. 
They are reportedly in a weakened state, so make 
sure you eliminate them before they recover. Each 
one will require a different strategy to defeat.

Predator 1 Challenge Mission: Difficulty 14
Aragami are apparently gathering in the subway 
remains. Eliminate the pack leaders - a Fierce 
Kongou, Fallen Chi-You, and magmatic Gboro-Gboro. 
A Blitz Hannibal has joined the fray to try and 
devour them, but it can be ignored for now.

context: Grants a constant +2 boost to Freeze

catalogue.description_en:
Predator 1 Enhance Mission: Difficulty 14
A Quadriga, magmatic Gboro-Gboro, and Chi-You
ambushed a squadron carrying materials relating to 
God Arc research through the Old City. They seem
stronger than usual, and we fear a drawn out battle. 
Equip freeze weaponry and take care with item usage.

Predator 1 Challenge Mission: Difficulty 14
Sariel are inhabiting a semi-constructed residential 
installation in the lower levels of Aegis. Swift 
elimination of Sariel, Fallen Sariel, and Aether is 
of utmost importance. Seems they've been feeding off 
the installation's Oracle supply and have mutated.

Predator 2 Survival Mission: Difficulty 14
Fallen Arda Nova have returned to Aegis Island and 
local Aragami are mutating in response. Eliminate 
them quickly, starting with Tezcatlipoca in the 
vicinity of Aegis. As the situation is critical, 
you only have three minutes to succeed.

Phase 2
Eliminate four polar Gboro-Gboro. Blaze equipment 
is recommended. As the situation is critical, you 
only have five minutes to succeed.

context: Extreme DEF and large ATK boost first 3 min.

catalogue.description_en:
Phase 3
Eliminate a Fallen Arda Nova. A shield with divine 
resistance will come in handy. It may only be for 
a short while, but a support unit should be able 
to help you out from anywhere in the operational 
area. You only have five minutes to succeed.

context: Medium ATK & DEF boost during Burst

catalogue.description_en:
Predator 2 Enhance Mission: Difficulty 14
R&D are developing techniques to detect Burst and 
provide support accordingly, and they need you to
help with field tests. Proceed to the plains and 
eliminate two Sekhmet, an Aether, and a Tsukuyomi. 
Try to maintain Burst for as long as possible.
